audit.why: The chart (Ziggs 1-2, Ziggs 3, Skill 4-5, Ziggs 6, Skill first item, Ziggs 2+) matches the packet levelChart and the mirror audit, which made no side flips here. The 50% figure rests on 14 games, so no edit was made that depends on the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike calls Perfect Execution a 'double-dash R' and gives no threshold or cooldown, and the first-item spike recommends armour against an AP assassin.
audit.why: Perfect Execution (R, 120/90/60s, 675 range) is a leap whose re-cast executes below an HP threshold — the number is what you play around, not the health bar. Akali's damage is overwhelmingly AP, so magic resist and Zhonya's are the first-item answers, not armour.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names the execute threshold and the 675 leap range; whys[5] changed from armour to MR/Zhonya's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every field treats Twilight Shroud as if it negates your poke, and nothing mentions her Assassin's Mark auto reset.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable by spells and attacks, but Bouncing Bomb (Q) and the Hexplosive Minefield (E) are ground-placed and still damage her inside the cloud — the shroud costs you aim, not damage. Assassin's Mark (P) is an auto-attack reset, so her burst opens on a wind-up rather than a cast.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, whys[2] and wants.foe[0] restated around the shroud breaking your aim; dontsFull[0].d now carries the Assassin's Mark wind-up tell.

edits.before: Level 3 Twilight Shroud makes it a true skill matchup around her engage.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud breaks your aim, not your Q and E damage inside the cloud.

edits.before: First-item armor/Zhonya's stops her one-combo and you out-range her.
edits.after: First-item MR or Zhonya's stops her one-combo and you out-range her poke.

edits.before: This is the coinflip window: her level 3 Shroud lets her walk your poke, but if you pre-drop E on your own feet and hold W, you punish her the instant she E-dashes in.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud only breaks your aim — ground Q and E still hit her inside it, so pre-drop the minefield on your own feet and hold the 20s Satchel for her Shuriken Flip dash.

edits.before: Her Perfect Execution double-dash R is the scary spike, but your R and W self-knockback let you disengage — never fight with your W on cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's second cast executes below a set HP number — track the number, not the bar, and hold Satchel to escape her 675-range leap.

edits.before: Use Twilight Shroud to negate your poke and set up the all-in
edits.after: Use Twilight Shroud to break your aim and set up the all-in

edits.before: Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: 850-range Q against her 550 Q: chip her on every last-hit before Twilight Shroud and Shuriken Flip exist.

edits.before: That is Akali’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Her burst opens with an empowered Assassin's Mark auto — that wind-up is your cue.
